industry.subtitle: Build state factories, mines, fields and farms, and license private ones. Plants turn inputs into goods, draw power, create jobs and add to growth; state plants' profits go to the treasury, private plants pay corporate tax.

industry.sellNote: Selling hands state plants to private investors for about four years of their after-tax profit. They keep running and employing the same people, but their profit no longer reaches the treasury: their owners pay corporate tax on it instead.
